rawText: make with risk management and it drives me crazy because if I would have learned this at the beginning of my journey I would have saved myself I think about a year and a half into my journey so the first point is risk management is percentage based system not dollar based system so let me explain so when you're going to go take a trade don't base it off money base it off of percentage so what does that mean so earlier to the example that I gave to you guys earlier if you have $11,000 in an account don't think of it oh I want to make $500 with the $1,000 cuz when you look at it in a percentage based system you have just made 50% of your account and a lot of people want to do that every single day every single other day once a week once a month and think about that for a second 50% a day 50% a week 50% a month those are all unrealistic numbers it's not going to happen now the opportunity is there for you to be able to do that but it's not something sustainable it's not something that you could do monthin and month out every single month so risk management is a percentage based system
